findings.finding: The subject-format compatibility adaptation preserves exact subject binding rather than accepting both old and new schemas.
findings.evidence: The subject file is a fixed packet-local path; its SHA comes from the fixed-hash accepted scope input_sha256 table. common.checked_json refuses a missing or wrong pin. Full file data must equal the inline exact_subjects list and V2 runtime subjects; legacy path/hash objects refuse. Current real load_inputs still validates exact IDs/images/configuration/source policies. The four new negatives cover inline contradiction, wrong pin, missing pin and legacy shape.

findings.evidence: Supplied launcher diff reproduces exactly. Hash-bound helper is unchanged and compiled under a non-main name. Both proof-source comparisons match only packet/module/date/attempt substitutions and the explicit fixed subject-file allowlist adaptation; no change to token parsing, private pipe, recipient or controller flow.

findings.finding: The real handoff module default remains inert and matches the saved proof exactly.
findings.evidence: verify_handoff_default.verify() invoked once and returned exit zero, saved receipt response equality, empty stderr, 26 allowlisted read-only os.open loader calls, zero counted operation tripwire calls and absent cutover marker before/after. No --execute-once call or real token read occurred. Scope/receipt preflight reads before guards and interpreter/import reads are not included in that 26 count.

findings.classification: SHOWN unchanged source; operational outcomes UNVERIFIED
findings.finding: No new cancellation, recovery, reservation or secrecy guarantee is established.
findings.evidence: Future execute path retains one exact original-orchestrator token-source read, bounded parser and private anonymous pipe to the controller, without wrapper retry. actual_default.result: Passed and exactly equal to saved handoff_default_proof.json

proof.proof_accounting: The single verify() call and exact saved-proof equality assertions completed successfully. A later manual proof-source normalization assertion failed because the module import directory date had not been normalized. Only the static comparison was corrected to include the explicit reviewed date-label substitution; it then passed. The actual default was not rerun.
proof.actual_cutover_default_receipt: Saved parent-produced 13-open receipt was read, hashed and checked against the reproduced handoff response. validate_cutover_default.validate() was not separately rerun by this reviewer.

budget_and_reservation.assessment: CLI verification and token-source inspection precede the controller budget. No whole-process deadline claim is made. Token-pipe read retains the existing controller's separate timeout. Marker precheck is advisory; atomic controller reservation and fresh validation remain necessary.

secrecy_and_cancellation.assessment: Token source selects the exact original orchestrator ID/image and running state. Parser admits one bounded SERVICE_TOKEN row only. Anonymous pipe and descriptor ownership remain unchanged; no environment/file/argv-token fallback was added. Future execution disables core dumps, but actual default never does so. Clearing references is not secure zeroization.
secrecy_and_cancellation.scope: Source comparison and synthetic failures only. No real token, live cancellation, SIGKILL, crash, daemon failure or recovery execution was exercised.
secrecy_and_cancellation.recovery_claim: Best-effort existing owned recovery only; no exact restoration, current health or guaranteed successful recovery asserted.

retained_limits: Acceptance is for exact offline handoff bindings and controlled default behavior, not service readiness, startup permission or a successful cited explanation.

All accepted packet limitations remain: MODELLED configuration/controller attestations, selected memory streams rather than complete image/dependency closure, restricted SDK scope and historical provenance for other pins.
Fresh identity/image/configuration/source/callable/namespace/fixed-recipient/storage-lineage/archive/body/witness/citation gates remain mandatory and are not declared passed here.

No native, real CLI, credential, DB, SDK, application or lifecycle operation was performed. The default proof covers its explicit hooks after setup/preflight, not a universal all-importer-effects proof.

The 26 count covers explicit allowlisted os.open loader calls over two loader passes, not every Path/interpreter read. Saved 13-open receipt is parent evidence; reproduced default response is independent offline proof.
Existing controller budget includes recovery but excludes earlier separate CLI/token checks; it is not a whole-wrapper 600-second bound.
Advisory marker absence grants no reservation or authority. No retry/reset, continuation, alternate packet or automatic follow-on execution is accepted.
Private source handling/reference clearing does not imply secure memory zeroization; receipt/audit/log effects and recovery limitations remain as previously reviewed.
Prior runtime unique cause, present native state, continuity, healthy rollback and future success remain UNVERIFIED.
